manifest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 of [sort(inventory, ordinal by path)], each line '<sha256>  <path>', joined with LF, no trailing newline

counts.basis: created = persisted tree minus the measured fresh-install baseline; imports through product controls count as created; message total counts chat AND group-chat JSONL user+assistant records

messageSplit.basis: 396 pairs were persisted by real sends through #send_textarea/#send_but; 772 pairs were appended to the page chat model and persisted through the product's own saveChatConditional. No JSONL was hand-written or copied.
messageSplit.disclosure: The corpus is NOT 100% UI-turn-originated for messages; the split is carried in the manifest and must be quoted downstream.

actionLogs.note: action logs stay OUTSIDE the repository; the manifest records their filenames and record count only

executed: round 1: bulk imports (cards/worldbooks/presets) through product import controls, hand-created character/lorebook subset, chats and groups through the UI
top-up over the same root: imports to the minimums, groups, chats and turns (fresh pinned process)
message top-up x2: proven send path + disclosed product-save-path fill (fresh pinned process)
gap-fill over the same root: created minima, pinned extension, verb matrix (fresh pinned process)

usePhase.target: copy of the corpus (copy-verify/corpus), never the root
usePhase.result: PASS preset-edit/temperature 0.77, PASS card-edit, FAIL card-duplicate (roster did not grow, before 33), PASS reload; chat turns reached no provider because the short phase does not configure a recorder (named harness limitation, no messages added)

restartPhase.target: copy of the corpus (copy-verify/corpus), never the root
restartPhase.result: PASS restart-resumed-persisted-chats (new pinned process reopened 3 persisted chats from the copy); FAIL restart-continued-generation (5 sends ~15 s each, no provider because the copy endpoint is dead and the short phase does not reconfigure it); report round31/round31.json

rounds.persistenceEvidence: the root itself was built across FOUR independent pinned server processes over the same data root (round1, top-up, message top-up, gap-fill); each later process reopened chats written by the earlier one, which is restart/persistence evidence even without the short phases The copy-run restart leg independently confirms resume across a new process.

extension.label: Tavern Helper / JS-Slash-Runner
extension.origin: frozen local bare mirror inside the data root; a page-triggered update cannot advance the checkout
extension.loading: manifest.json, dist/index.js, dist/index.css served 200 by the unmodified frontend
extension.api: globalThis.TavernHelper present; chat variable A19_GAPFILL_VAR set and read back through the helper API ({before: {}, after: {A19_GAPFILL_VAR: 'gapfill-1794204371385'}})
extension.enablement: auto-enabled at load; the Extensions-panel toggle was not found, so step extension-enabled-through-ui is recorded FAILED by design while load+API are green
extension.egressFinding: during load the pinned extension itself issued ONE request to https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/novi028%2FJS-Slash-Runner/repository/files/manifest.json/raw?ref=main (status 200); this is the pinned product's extension version check, NOT the provider or the harness, and a strictly offline CI job must block it at the network boundary

verbs.notes: pinned edits a contenteditable .mes_text (not a textarea); delete must click a VISIBLE confirm because #dialogue_popup_ok is a permanent hidden element (same trap as New Chat)

measuredCosts.fullCorpusWallClockMinutes: approx 60 across four pinned processes (one partial round, bulk top-up, message top-up, gap-fill)
